notes.title: How to Play johnsgame in 2023
notes.content:
2 Years ago I spent a long time making sure you could play each version. So here is that post reposted so it's still known. New game coming this year, 2023 is going to be huge.

Each Version of the game is playable from the RTS version to the 3rd iteration of the survival mode of the game. 

To play johnsgame in all four ways simply:
1. Right-Click the game in your steam library-
2. -and click the 'Properties' tab.
2. Then, go to the 'Betas' Tab-
3. -and click the drop down menu that has the words "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs"
4. Clicking that should show you all 4 versions of the game.
5. Choose which version you want to play. 
6. Update the game.

TO FIX ANY PROBLEM SAYING THE EXE IS MISSING:
1. Go to 'Properties' again.
2. Then go to the 'Local Files' tab.
3. Click "Browse local files".
4. Rename the exe by right clicking it and clicking rename. 
5. Rename the exe to either "johnsgame.exe" or "wastelander.exe"

If that doesn't work try restarting steam by going to the bottom right of your screen and clicking the up arrow on your taskbar near where it shows the time of day and then just right click the steam icon and click exit.

Thanks for reading and still playing my first game. I am happy to finally have solved this issue i have had.
I have also realized I could probably remake johnsgame if i wanted to so I am planning on that still now that i have learned a lot since i first released the game. It is my favorite game it's just unfortunate i never had the help or the knowledge i do now when i first made it. It's a very deep game with a lot to do in it depending on what version you are on and it sucks a lot of people didn't get to experience it because it was broken for so long.

Additionally added (3/5/2023)
I am currently making something multiplayer and am determined.

notes.title: The Next Game and about me.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27870273/1394d5336566472c1050545f4cfbe9cb1e9b2b47.png[/img]
Hello, I am creating something new and I hope this looks at all promising.

I am sorry for how the game ended up. After Version 2 (you can find what I mean by the previous news article) I was unable to access the files due to both GameMaker: Studio corrupting my files and a Windows update that required a Windows Reset which wiped my computer to get it to work. After that, Version 3 and 4 were created but without the same passion and more of "I just need to remake it" but I didn't remember how I did it the first time and constant frustration only came to make very good but depressing art which matched what i was going for but was only a reflection of my then feelings.

I also made the game when I was 14 and didn't release it on Steam till I was maybe 15 (before that it was, and might still be on GameJolt as a privated game or something but I don't remember my login). At the same time I was making johsn.game I was making Obscure Realm. Another game ruined by a Windows Update/Reset with the only GIF I have of it is this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27870273/f4fb3a83fb0db341b70fa97f2d4ea976a0f0e7c1.gif[/img]
The only version you can find of this game is either if you already have it somehow on Steam or you find the old version on GameJolt.

I am currently creating a remake of the game. Now, as an almost 20 year old, I have learned a lot about Game Design, Game Feel, Art, and Managing a Team. 

The new game has two others, a programmer, and a sound designer. 

My current state of life is I will be going to DigiPen for Game Design on July 9th to get used to the area before school starts in August. In the meantime I will be creating the new game with these two others and even during my stay at the school (but not using their property of course because then it wouldn't be mine). 

Anyways, the new game will be top-down and and have a look like the gif below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27870273/09b61ae1db3234e18e3dfc3128f1062a61ccf954.gif[/img]
DONT WORRY, this looks like this for a reason, shadows can be added in-engine (we are using Godot) and has a lot of this higher-resolution art. The reason I do show this GIF is because I want to show off what I am going to be doing for all Art, making it more complex.

Even though this looks pretty:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27870273/2eb9e5c8c4b1fefde035a2fa9ce26c223a8927c6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27870273/5e2fb30163551be2d0f42c6983af5ae6eeb462ed.jpg[/img]

The new game will be based and inspired by media like a boy and his dog, fallout 1, state of decay 2, and of course johns.game. 



you should watch a boy and his dog: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UWIzcJ1Neg&t=464s

notes.title: Newsletter of Doom!: Week 11: Obscure Realm, johns.game
notes.content:
[h1]Obscure Realm: [b]Additional Help, Phase 1[/b][/h1]
[b]Additional Help:[/b] I was looking for help with developing Obscure Realm and then I had a few people come to me saying they could help. Yes, they gave some good ideas for art and etc but I could tell they are just 'Idea Men' (Idea Men are people who just sit around giving ideas without real effort in making those ideas come to light/happen) and they wanted to take my game for themselves. This sucks. So now if someone does in fact want to help develop this game with me then they need to tell me exactly what they want to do in detail instead of a vague idea. Thank you.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/f4fb3a83fb0db341b70fa97f2d4ea976a0f0e7c1.gif[/img]

[b]Phase 1:[/b] Obscure Realm's first area of the game has been remade (as far as I want you to play anyways), the sewer area is playable to those who would like to. At the same time I am looking for those who would like to help just look over the game, give small ideas about what could be better, changed, or added. If you would like to have access to this please feel free to message me for access to this. I will be using GameJolt to do testing. Using the original projects page as a way to see the testing be in use making it so you can play the current version and last years version. Without request you can play last years version but to play this year I need to add you to a list of people so you can download and play at anytime. If this is to hard for you to have a GameJolt account then I do have Dropbox that I can give links to but thats only if its dire.

[h1]johns.game:[b]Its been on my mind[/b][/h1]
Lately, when I have been free, I have been thinking about recreating the engine from scratch for johns.game. This would be a great thing and in turn would revive johns.game to a player base as if everything worked the game would be quite fun. The problem is the game would be oddly different as Locations, Survival, and some Quests would be altered. For the people who have played the Steam Version at least 30 minutes. How would you feel about this change, and for those who just play the working GameJolt version how would you feel if the game was changed fully to Survival with no added mini-games?

I have done some side help with other games and created johns.game and learned a few things. Obscure Realm has reflective and shadow lighting. [h1]The New Schedule: Whats happening?[/h1]
It's been a rusty 2 weeks, a broken update, weird add-ons
that were more or less just a distraction, sorry.
Now there is, for now, a permanent schedule for how updates
and newsletters will go out. 
Every Sunday the 'News Letter of Doom' will come out for everyone to read at 10am Eastern Standard.
 Then, if I have anything else to say then a 'Part 2' will also be released. Every Saturday is
the day I will be writing the 'News Letter of Doom' so
if you have anything you would like to say just shoot
me a message on Steam.

small. At the beginning of the week at the very bottom of
the newsletter will show everything that is planned to come
out and at the end of the week the 'Change-Log' and update will
show exactly what does end up coming out.
Also for anyone who did not know we have a Steam Group for
Obscure Studios, this will also be regularly updated.

Updates will come out every week BUT once a week.
This gives people a set time to go and play the update every 
Saturday. Updates will be worked on from the start of the week
to the end of the week. Any ideas sent to me will be put off to
the next week unless its small add-on or its a fix. This new
updates has a few fixes mainly achievement fixes.

"Oh boy" an old friend once told me when I first told him I
wanted to make games, Obscure Realm wasn't my first idea but
it was the first I released. This person was Jeremy, a good
but not so around friend anymore, this is for you Jeremy.

Obscure Realm, this first Idea put to code will be released on
Steam in early October this year. Development is being worked on
and it will be as hard, and confusing as it was before. This time
you will have a real reason to go forward in the game. The previous
GameJolt release made people love it. Tons of feedback was received,
lots of things were fixed. But this, basically a remaster, will be the best top-down game you could possibly think off. Story,
Shops, BETTER COMBAT, and everything I learned from johns.game.
This may seem like just a jumble of information but really its
just an excited yet worried me getting ready to go back to an
old project. The game was already voted YES back in early February.
I have provided a link to the Greenlight Page, and the GameJolt page.

A Challenge for you, its very simple. Beat the GameJolt version
and you get the game for free on release.
To prove this you must share a screenshot of level 63, you
will know when you get there. That's it, its that simple.
A reward will be there waiting at the end. ːSBpandaːː2015hollyː[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27870273/6c356d9b5e0e514210ec55ab832803e54ab30bcd.png[/img]

notes.title: News Letter of Doom: Week 4: Updates, Settlements, Nukapedia, Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Why Updates are taking so Long:[/h1]
Recently I have moved to a new area, meeting new faces, expressing new feelings, and being overall more happy. Where I used to live I really had no one around that I wanted to talk to so I was unable to update this game pretty much daily. Now that I have more people in my life its harder to so updates will be more weekly than daily. I just wanted to inform you all. 

[h1]Settlements:How they work (or should have)[/h1]
Over the last week I was working on adding settlements, just another thing to distract you in the game. But after I had spent a week on this I had realized that this would not make any sense, your character has no idea how to run a settlement and would be to shook after watching what happened to the group of people he tried to lead. John is a family man, not a full blown leader. So now I have moved on and at most you will be able to pay people to do tasks for you but you will not be able to choose where and how people work. How settlements would have worked is YES you would have to pay the people with food, water, shelter, and coin, but you would get great benifits of doing so. You would have animal and C.C attacks on your town as the C.C are trying to take over the planet. There would have been a lot to do but I need to keep this game to the Lore.

[h1]Nukapedia:[/h1]
Recently I have been going on Nukapedia for new ideas to add to the game. For those of you who don't know, Nukapedia is the Fandom site for Falllout games. I used to read this all the time just for the Hell of it but now I am reading it for ideas. I highley recommend reading it. So far I have gotten a few quest and weapon ideas from this if you have not noticed already. I stick more towards Fallout: New Vegas, the best Fallout game in my opinion.
If you want to go check it out to read or to help here is a link:
http://fallout.wikia.com/wiki/Portal:Fallout:_New_Vegas

[h1]Summer Sale:[/h1]
The Steam Summe Sale is coming up soon. If you would like to share this game with your friends but they won't get it for the $2.00 price range then during the summer the game will be 30% off. Just a forwarning. Hopefully during this time more people will be active parts of the community. 

(Also kind-of looking for more steam emoticons)
How to talk soon! ːSBpandaːː2015hollyː

Its is now the third week of the News Letter of Doom, the news letter I started to keep peoples minds off the fact that there were no new updates but now the ball is rolling again, new ideas are being made, things are happening.

[h1]johns.game:[/h1]
There are so many little things in johns.game like for instance why the game is called johns.game, little meanings to everything. Real reasons for everything. One thing that you notice right off the bat (if look at the controls and test them) is that the frame-rate is generally always around 11-13 FPS, the reason for this is not to 'cap' the FPS but to make the game work exactly how it needs to (like how Horizon: Zero Dawn sets things to run around 30 FPS to make the world seem-less). All of the timers for food, water, posion, stuff like that is set to work better around this level and if it was any higher the game would be way to hard.

[h1]Pixel Art:[/h1]
I am slowly realizing more and more that I do in fact need a pixel artists help. Things I want to add like canyons, new buildings, foliage, etc. I can not due to my limiting skill with the subject. This shows up in the game by lack of more new content. The new area that is being promised might even have to hold off till 4. because it would mean I would have to try as hard as I can to create new pixel art for the game when in reality I can not. So if you know anyone who would want to or maybe even you, feel free to add me.

For the last week & 1/2 johns.game has recieved no updates. Well today after a long wait the game has been updated. This update brings new ways of the world, weird people to find, and cheats. News Letter of Doom: Week 2: 2 Weeks, 2,000 Copies
notes.content:
[h1]The News:[/h1]
Today I worked on adding another gun to the game (SMG) and worked on IJ^0. I have decided on the fact that there is not real reason to add a veichle to the game on the count that all it would do is add more stress to the game and another over-powered item thats just not needed. Though it will stay in the back of my mind to add don't count on it any time soon, sorry.

Jason's shop was added back in the same place but not for long as we will soon be adding some type of Market Town where player(s) will be able to go and trade for weapons, metals, and foods. Concept art is already being drawn up for this town as it will be an entire new area of the map, like the forest area, it will be for higher players that can handle a challenge. This area will be at the end of the road players can currently find near Paleta and IJ^0.

Equiptable armour is seeming to be quite a challenge.

[h1]Happy 2000:[/h1]
After a Month & a half since release we have now reached 2,000 copies/units sold on Steam. This may seem like a very small amount but think about the fact that most of this was over the last 2 weeks. Hearing about this and then seeing this completley made my day and I just wanted to let you all know that this a large community of players and with everyones help we can make this game better than it ever can be!

[h1]Collisions in games, and 'if' statements:[/h1]
I am slowly realizing objects colliding with other objects is what makes up 1/3-2/3rds of my game. Why is this? Its because games are generally a bunch of what if's. Lets say you press the 'F' key, what happens? Well IF you press the 'F' key then it does 'X', you understand then props. Lets say this, if my players bullet hits another object, well this needs to have a cause and effect or the bullet will simply pass through the other object because it does not register as an object because you did not tell the bullet to do anything. Now lets tell the bullet to do something, like IF the bullet COLLIDES with the other object -2 HP, or maybe the bullet gets destroyed. Hope somebody understands even though this kind of made no sense.

[h1]Stuff with Zrrr:[/h1]
The new Programmer & Pixel Artist that was talked about in the previous [u][i]'News Letter of Doom'[/i][/u] fell through and will not be joining the team so as always it will just be me and the musician. We are currently looking for submissions of amazing new ideas that could change the face of how you play the game. (Maybe if someone wanted to write a guide???)

Goodnight everyone, sleep well, and keep your firearm loaded incase of attack.You never know whats out in the Baron Desert. ːSBpandaːː2015hollyː
